name: Girlfriend
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of guarding the heart diligently, recognizing that it directs the course of life, especially in relationships such as those between boyfriends and girlfriends. The wisdom of Proverbs cautions against giving one's strength to relationships that can lead to destruction, highlighting the value of purity and self-control before marriage. Finding a wife is portrayed as a blessing from the Lord, underscoring the sacredness of the marriage covenant. Furthermore, the New Testament calls husbands to love their wives sacrificially, reflecting Christ's love for the church, and affirms that marriage is honorable and the proper context for intimate relationships, warning that God will judge immoral behavior outside of this covenant.
